title: Coffee, Croissants and Cribbage
description: 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM · Coffee, croissants and cribbage is back! Come by the library Magazine Room 10-11:30am for friendly competition, free coffee and pastries, and community connection. May the nibs be with you.

title: Dr. Howard Kornfeld of Physicians for Social Reponsibility
description: 4:30 PM – 5:30 PM · Dr. Howard Kornfeld, former Telluride resident, and now with Physicians for Social Responsibility , will be in coversation with Art Goodtimes about peace and nuclear disarmament. Free and open to all! A Note From Howard Kornfeld, MD "It's a real joy to be coming back to Telluride. I lived here in the mid 1980's, as well as some time in Grand Junction and Boulder. I was doing emergency medicine work and, thanks to Art Goodtimes, was quickly educated about the local challenges to the alpine ecology posed by the mining activity in past decades. Learning about how to safeguard the tailings as well as keeping the aquifer healthy was a fascinating ecological extension of my background in human health. I enjoyed many aspects of Telluride, including attending the Mushroom Festival three years in a row. …
